author: Rune0
quote: I used to love booting up AC. It was a fun journey into a (fairly accurate) historical period never before experienced. In Current Year(TM) all of that is gone. This is history perverted to meet the needs of affection-starved fetishists and serves only as an insult to the culture it pretends to honour. The people writing this game need to lose their jobs for putting their own sick fantasies in a game meant to appeal to millions. Wild inaccuracy and neurotic staff aside it is a BAD game thoroughly eclipsed by Ghost of Tsushima (whose team nailed what AC was supposedly aiming for with a team and budget a fraction of the size). Play ACS for a few hours and then play GoT. The difference is night and day. At times Shadows feels like an indie knockoff of GoT and that only leads us to ask - where did the money go? Certainly not on the writing team. The issues wouldn't matter if this were a FUN game. It is not and you might feel it wasn't mean to be. This is where Ubi's hubris has brought them. Anyone who tells you the game is finally finished is lying to you. The difference in minimal and it is still a buggy, unfinished mess. Even Bethesda would baulk at this game. Cyberpunk 2077 has been carried by the cult of personality of Keanu from day one and now it is carried by the success of Edgerunners and other admittedly stellar actors. The presentation of the game is what keeps it alive. Anyone currently mashing the dislike button ought to question how and why they continue to play it. It is not for the game itself. The story and characters are what keep people coming back and in a video GAME that is not enough. While Dark Souls is all game and little story, Cyberpunk is the opposite - all story and very little game. They have not fixed it and anyone telling you it's a 10 and the fullest realisation of what they originally promised (but didn't deliver) is a liar. quote: A fun Roguelite that sabotages itself with a saturation of un-funny humour and shoehorned identity politics (see : a trait that states your character likes both boys and girls that adds nothing to the RPG aspect of the game. Few people in 2023 are going to be angered by the presence of certain preferences in games but this feels like the makers have shoehorned even more of it into the sequel. The game partially builds on its predecessor but feels as if it is lacking in some areas. It is a fun game but the boring lore and pushing of certain preferences are not needed in a game that one ought to be marketing to the masses. I find myself playing it in spite of these annoyances rather than taking them as a crucial aspect of the game. The Dark Souls Lite approach to lore is also lame and along with the 'humour' should be resigned back to Failarmy circa 2013. Mechanics-wise it's fun and the new abilities (or repurposed old ones) feel satisfying. Dropping the obnoxious writing style and the other aspects would help broaden this games appeal. It could be marketed to children and adults alike but it seems content to settle in it's little niche, unfortunately rendering it average.

author: Rune0
quote:
TLDR
Good : Stunning graphics, fun dino dynamics

Bad : Shut up Aloy, Weird disconnect with the combat/hitboxes, **** bugs not ironed-out, soulless npcs nobody cares about.

Overall : Visual style over gameplay substance but still worth playing (at least until Elden Ring comes out).

It's more of the same style over substance with HFW. The cast of characters all look like castoffs from the 90s show Tribe and the different tribes are all barely-distinguishable hippies in dayglo facepaint. The story is godawful and you will find yourself skipping through it because you just do not care about facepainted npc #9002. The world is stunningly beautiful to look at but poorly-designed (think AC Odyssey). A lot of it is irrelevant wilderness. An open world game can feel vast even if it doesnt have hundreds of miles of world. HFW feels like a lot of copypasted textures and areas. The combat sorely needs a lock on. Whether owing to bugs or poor design you will often find yourself getting one-shot by things not appearing on screen/appearing too late or too early. The hitboxes are all over the place. The biggest stumbling block and the worst offender is Aloy (chubby face aside). Where once she was endearing now she is a **** tutorial bore. She is constantly, constantly, constantly, constantly quipping. You will audibly tell her to shut up and you will do it into the double digits. There are times where you are not even afforded the chance to solve a basic Zelda 'shoot-the-glowy-thing' puzzle without Aloy straight up telling you what to do. This game treats you like a dribbling moron. And this is with the accessibility options turned off. You cannot take in the beauty of this game without wishing its protagonist would shut up. If you pick up a rock she quips. If you pick up a plant she quips. If you take longer than 5seconds to solve a puzzle she quips and tells you what to do. This makes the game a tour. And it ****. Because it could be a GOTY contender if Aloy were quieter and made to fit into the games world more. There is an odd disconnect at times and she will clip through things. This game is another case of 'look at the pretty graphics! never mind the glitchy gameplay!'.

author: Rune0

author: Rune0
quote:
Pros: Beautiful graphics, Fan-pleasing content, Better combat than Ninja Storm games
Cons: Shallow gameplay sections, Incoming microtransactions, Butchered cast, Graphical effects can be blinding at times

It is a fun game but suffers from a lack of content and looming microtransactions that make the full price tag feel too much. The graphical style is great but the game is an arena fighter with some tacked-on 'walk in a straight line' missions. There is a part where you walk in a straight line while some dialogue plays and you can pick up 2 items directly in front of you. Megaselling Ghibli Slayer or not - this is bad 'gameplay'. Cutscenes transformed into walking sessions for the player are only there to give the illusion of content and they need to go. There is some beautiful gaming here but unfortunately it is right next to some of the laziest and worst examples of modern gaming. If they copypasted this graphical style onto a Sekiro engine it would print money (assuming they added a Games Journalist Easy Mode for non hardcore gamer fans).
game_title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles

author: Rune0
quote:
More new content and a whole stunning island to explore. This is DLC done right. And the upgrade to ps5 specs makes the game even more beautiful. You will not regret buying this game.

See my previous review below:

Ghost of Tsushima is a stunning game. I have never before played a game with such a vibrant open world. It feels lived-in, it feels living. Before GoT I never experienced ASMR from a video game. Now I do. The falling of leaves, petals etc make this a magical world akin to something from a Studio Ghibli film. Equal parts Journey, Bushido Blade and Tenchu this is a game that has been constructed to please the people who forked out for it. Comparing it to TLOU2 is unfair to Naughty Dog because GoT blows it away. I dont know why anyone would choose TLOU2's edgelord nihilism over the magic of GoT - a game whose creators went out of their way to make enjoyable. Also comparisons to Assassins Creed persist but speaking as a fan of AC since the first one (though not so much recently) I am not throwing the games under the bus when I say that AC has never been this good. Not even close. Jin Sakai is a great MC who veers away from the preaching that has become commonplace in Western games and proves that gamers do not need forced MCs who mirror them at the threat of twitter mob outrage. There could be a case made that it is not as long as some other open world games but I would counter that there is no extraneous flab in GoT. Just classy, relevant substance. Its side missions serve a purpose, add to the plot and build the world Jin is trying to save. The add fuel to Jin's desire to save it at all costs. It is so refreshing to have side missions that serve a purpose and aren't just 'Deliver this persons frying pan'. It is a game that makes you care about its casts philosophies without badgering you with encyclopedias on why you're supposed to care (a la Death Stranding). Its world is magical and you want to protect it as much as Jin does. It isnt an exercise in making you feel like crap like TLOU2. It captures the essence of nature and play (which in reality are intertwined anyway). Ghost of Tsushima is a strong contender for Game of the Year and it would take something godlike to deny it.

author: Rune0
quote:
The director's cut adds a new area, a racetrack, some songs, a few missions and a few items. What caused them to think that this games ATROCIOUS driving warranted a race track I do not know. It is abhorrent. The new area (building and top of a hill) is beautiful but really is something that was cut out in order to sell back to us later on. Wait for the price to fall. It isnt 2deep4u. It is a walking sim given a kojima makeover with added urination and poop jokes. This is the point where we must stop kissing Hideo's rear because his games are suffering. From the visionary who brought us the first 3 MGS games we are right in expecting more. Maybe its time he left video games to people who enjoy playing them and just go off to make movies.

For my original review see below:

First and foremost It is a walking sim. The presentation and actors are great and the world looks beautiful but there is very little actual gameplay fun to be had here. Hideos intentions are honourable verging on sickly but the point persists that video games must be fun and there is very little to be found in DS. This is exactly the kind of bloated movie with added game that konami canned him for. In no way is it acceptable to have to skip the same 4 cutscenes every time just to shower. I would urge players to note the amount of times they have thought 'just let me play the game'. And from past experience we know that games that do this lack gameplay - MGS4 for example. At this point Hideo should just go and make movies because the severe amount of bloated pointless garbage in this game renders gameplay an afterthought. It is charming: the cast are great and a few terrible lines aside its a fairly solid (sorry) story. But it is a lot less smart than it believes itself to be. It is everything questionable/bad about Hideos games and please note i am saying this as a fan of 20years and having completed DS and nearly Platinum'd it. It is blatant that Kojima has played and attempted to ripoff games like Journey and Firewatch. DS is a big budget faux-hollywood version of these games. Isolation is a theme throughout but upon beating the game it feels more like an excuse for foisting an empty world on us. I will never condone konamis practices but after experiencing DS i can understand why they kept tabs on the Kojimaisms in all the games hes released. This is not an MGS2-esque prophecy that will be relevant in a decade - it is a knee-jerk pander piece trying to cash in on modern political paranoia. What many will refuse to admit is that after making a series based on the Patriots system of control you spend DS building one yourself amid claims that it will 'bring da people togevur'. The formula for the gameplay we do get is 'Go from A to B dodging ghosts or humans - meet thank you hologram - rinse and repeat' and it is not good enough. I cannot tell you how many times my thumb ached from holding the same direction for minutes on end. A total lack of dynamism. It is honestly an amazon simulator and any majesty the world had evaporates when you can build roads through it. I have lost a lot of faith in my usual trusted reviewers because theyre calling this game a 9+/10 and that is nowhere near true.
Hideo is a genius and the world sorely needs his games. But this is barely a game. I think we have reached the point where he should just go and make movies because this game is an afterthought attached to one.

author: Rune0
quote:
Tl:dr : A genuinely special game everyone ought to try.

It really is an experience. While killjoys might call it limited or dated it hearkens back to when game designers had to make the most of what they had - not slap on 50hour cutscenes (Hi Hideo) or copy and paste an empty environment of irrelevant space (Hi Asscreed). It isnt a huge game but what it is is a game of relevant largeness. It isnt all a world of emptiness and space for spaces sake. The soundtrack is brilliant. Combat is good but lacks a feel of weight. While there arent a million magical arts they do stay true to the original. The story is every bit as eclectic as one would expect. In a world where Hideo Kojima has disappeared up his own rear end the world needs more Yoko Taros.

This game has soul. Many games lack it nowadays. Rather than ripping off the latest fad game designers ought to take spiritual inspiration from Nier and Taro.

author: Rune0
quote:
Tl:dr - A better cyberpunk game than cyberpunk 2077 that unfortunately suffered from the curse of Get Woke : Go Broke (the red flag signifying unfinished games trying to coast on their politics) and rampant microtransactions. There was a top game here that was butchered with the intent to sell back to us. As ever - ignore anyone who tries to tell you this is a 10.

There are the makings of a 9 or 10 here but as it is it isnt worthy of it. The game is unfinished. Not 'cyberpunk 2077 unfinished' but 'missing a couple of Acts' unfinished. Its clear these cuts were made with the intention of selling them to us at a later date (and the storm surrounding the games microtransactions put paid to that). They shouldve learned their lesson from the prequel. Obnoxious attempts to relate it to current (then and now) politics sour the narrative and induce cringe.
Jensen is a great near iconic protagonist who deserves better. The game wouldve been a smash if they had focused on finishing it rather than vulturizing it with intent to sell it back to us.

Looter sho...slasher mechanic is tired.

author: Rune0
quote: Its the same game as 7 re-sold with a faux-bloodborne makeover. Movement is still agonisingly slow. Shooting isnt so much better than its not as bad as it was in 7. Lets dispense with the LOL STEP ON ME MOMMY stupidity - shes barely in the game. The game has been speedran(runned?) already clocking in at just over an hour. This is another lazy effort from capcom after the resi arcade waste of time that was remake3. Every time you give them your money you allow them to put out garbage like this.  'Oh but the OG resident evils were short!' - Yes in the 90s. Decades ago. Its blatant that theyre botting metacritic because in no way is this game a 10. Wait for the shill cheques to clear and then see what people really think of this game before buying. You have been warned.

author: Rune0
quote: Disregard anyone calling this a 10. It isnt. Nowhere near. They are bots or paid shills. Do not pay £/$70. This game is not worth that price. This is a pretty game that wears out its welcome quickly. Bullet hell games shouldnt have hit detection this poor. The random nature ruins any meaningful flow and quickly becomes the equivalent of banging your head against a brick wall until it crumbles randomly. At times it is fun but it lacks basic features that are mandatory in 2021. And **** is missing basic features it does not warrant full price. Ever. This is your typical 'look at the pretty graphics look at the pretty graphics lol nevermind the lack of content' early new gen game. It will be free on ps plus as soon as ps5s are available again. I saw reviews saying it uses the new ps5 controller better than Astros Playroom and to that i say BS. Aesthetically it is pleasing and the sound is good. But it is **** (if that). It feels like the add on thats unlocked after completing a campaign. It tries hard to make repetition a gimmick but the discerning gamer wont buy that. Buy this second hand (its readily available at a reduced price already).

author: Rune0
quote: Got it free as part of a ps5 bundle (the only way to get a ps5 currently it seems). It is apparent that with every passing year they charge you more and sell you less ****. It is unfinished and STILL suffers from the same issues COD has always suffered with. Connection issues that make it more a battle of internet providers than of skill etc etc etc. A game that sells as much as COD shouldnt have these problems. It certainly should not be released unfinished. If call of effing duty is allowed to release unfinished then gaming is in deep trouble. Stop buying these games. Stop supporting it. Games-as-service needs to go. If we continue to send money towards these games then we will deserve everything we get. Stop funding your own exploitation.
game_title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War

author: Rune0
quote:
I do not recommend playing this 'game'. I hesitate to call it a game because your progress is barely dependent on skill - Either you roll the latest top character in the game or you dont.I give it a 1 because it does have some fun aspects and was a life support for Bleach during the years prior to the animes return but truly BBS is a gambling machine. For the trolls : yes I know very well that this is a gacha but that is zero excuse for the abhorrent practices at work with this game. The new player has a rank system that is there to peer pressure them into spending real money on orbs to gamble for a CHANCE to get a character that is usually the difference between staying in your league and being demoted. The chances for certain gamebreaking characters are infinitesimally low yet seem to rise when one spends real money (funny that). This 'game' also features a subscription service that TAKES AWAY the bonus items given should you cancel the subscription. Completely and utterly unacceptable.

No game should ever make you grind for months and have nothing to show for it. There is no merit in this game - either you get the gamebreaking character or you dont.

This is gambling disguised as a video game and it needs to go.

author: Rune0
quote:
I expected to hate it. I thought it was vapid shovelware but I was wrong. It is a charming love letter to the playstation's history and is a great demo of all of the new ps5 controller functions. The haptic feedback is great. You can feel the grass as you trot along, the wind as you struggle against it and the water as you dive in. I did not expect the poignant 'oof' moments this game gave me as it showcased just how far PS and the gamer have come. It is like if mario galaxy morphed into a love letter to playstation. It is short but considering the depth of things to do its the perfect solution for parents who want to keep their kids away from their Demon's Souls save files. I dare anyone to not be charmed by this. It gets a 6 on the basis that it is a tech demo but it is more than that would suggest. If they doubled the size and marketed it to kids it could be a huge hit.
I expected to hate it - after playing it i just couldn't.

author: Rune0
quote:
Its a 5/10. A ps5 game shouldnt control like this even if it is meant to be a 'faithful remake' (it isnt). The content is too light and there needed to be more items/armour/weapons (and I dont mean level locked special edition weapons that are useless as soon as you leave 1-1). The game visually is stunning (as it should be) bar the facial expressions of the characters. These are not good. Ps2 tier. Theyre not grotesque in the endearing way like in other Soulsborne games. They are just bad. Mass Effect Andromeda bad. And to address the elephant in the room and trigger hatemail - this is what happens when you let a non-japanese team make a souls game. American politics from the get go mar this game. The rubix cube characterisation is idiotic and is not needed in a japanese game made originally by japanese people. It only serves to show why so many people adopt a 'japanese games only' approach - theyre tired of propaganda in video games. There was none of this in any of the From Games prior. Consider it testament to how politics in the west ruin everything in gaming. I have a feeling that in the years to come we will look back on this game in embarrassment as blind pandering led to more offensive portrayals than it might ever have destroyed. I will say 'Satsuki' and move on. The control scheme doesnt make the most of the ps5's raw power. It still feels 'choppy'. Memes and player message palettes bordering on walkthroughs also have no place in Souls games. Souls games became popular because they were always themselves. They taught you rather than pandered to you. Reducing them to dated meme machines does them a huge disservice. We dont need pop anime or Simpsons references in games because all they do is lower the games content to the value of clickbait list fodder.

tldr : DS got a AAA makeover making it pretty but in return was made every bit as vapid as that classification suggests by the western stupidity injected into it.

author: Rune0
quote:
tl:dr - It's a broken Deus Ex Theft Auto with added sex toys.
Yes it is broken. Still. As of February 2021 it does not fall above the threshold for being considered a finished product.
It is out a year early judging by the lack of polish (pun intended).
The glitches and bugs are too numerous to list here. There are A LOT. Never have I had a game that crashes my ps4 more than this one.
Given a years more work and polish the game would be a GOTY contender.
I personally wouldnt put it above Ghost of Tsushima based on the fact that GOT is a lovingly crafted game that never crashed on me once,
has interconnected side missions that actually contribute to the story and
has a better environment.
I understand that Night City IS the main antagonist in Cyberpunk but that doesnt make it any nicer a world to exist in.
GOT is a world that surrounds you with the brutality and beauty of nature.
Night City is a hole of excrement that you can hardly blame Johnny for wanting to burn to the ground.
I would be interested in knowing just how many people would ever choose to save it in a Life is Strange Bae or Bay type choice.
I would bet a prosthetic limb or two that most would crater-ize it.
In current year the adult content is cringeworthy and embarrassing and not needed in a video game.
Think Custer's Revenge level idiocy.
Adult toys are everywhere and after the original 3 second duration of 'lol benis'
they become embarrassing and make the player wonder if it maybe isnt time to put the controller down and do something more worthy of your time.
It isnt mature or provocative. Its irrelevant and we have seen it all before.
Gameplay wise it is in the vein of Bioshock or Deus Ex but set in a sub-GTA sandbox.
I do not recommend this game.
For all its strengths (the city looks nice-ish when it bothered to load up) it is not complete.
Wait a year minimum and see if they can salvage this. Do not pay full price for this game. £20 max.
If they add multiplayer with paid DLC then avoid this like the plague.

author: Rune0
quote: I gave ubisoft a chance. I will not be doing it again. This is the same politics-infected mess we have come to expect from them and now is the time to stop funding it. AC games used to be brutal but joyous reveries into history. Now it is giving the Reddit inclusivity treatment to every time period and, as 1984 tells us, the destruction of history is a red flag (pun intended). Ubisoft - we see through your preaching even if you try to include it as metaphor. There is zero point to making a historical video game if you dont even try to make it reminiscent of the time. We can make do with things left out or changed due to a lack of historical knowledge but ACV outright lies to our faces and that is unacceptable. Surely I dont need to highlight the irony of preaching about justice in a game about Assassins. Gamewise its the same copypasted Origin and Odyssey gameplay with minimal differences no doubt from the equally historically-incorrect Vikings tv show.

author: Rune0
quote: It is a love letter to the fans and brings the series full circle in a way that had me smiling from ear to ear. In an age where many games try to preach politics at the consumer this game is a handshake and a pat on the back for supporting the series and keeping the faith all these years. More modern games ought to try and please their fans in this way. It gets an 8. While not a titanic leap forward in universe it reminds you of all that you ever loved about DMC (no not that one).

author: Rune0
quote: Ive been with Tekken since 2 and have completed every game since and this one is the worst. Characters and content intentionally ripped out to be sold over the course of 3 years then patched multiple times. They sold us ****. I beat the story mode in a night. They rushed this game out. Combat is even more reliant on an idiotic juggling system and Akuma shouldnt be in the game by virtue of not being beholden to the games rules. For the first time in my life I will not be getting tekken on launch when 8 comes out because 7 has been a joke. The music is awful (as all tekken music has been since 3) and the stage environments are lacking. Overall this is a dull soulless half-game spread thinly over 3years. Its time people stopped paying for butchered games.

author: Rune0
quote: Ghost of Tsushima is a stunning game. I have never before played a game with such a vibrant open world. It feels lived-in, it feels living. Before GoT I never experienced ASMR from a video game. Now I do. The falling of leaves, petals etc make this a magical world akin to something from a Studio Ghibli film. Equal parts Journey, Bushido Blade and Tenchu this is a game that has been constructed to please the people who forked out for it. Comparing it to TLOU2 is unfair to Naughty Dog because GoT blows it away. I dont know why anyone would choose TLOU2's edgelord nihilism over the magic of GoT - a game whose creators went out of their way to make enjoyable. Also comparisons to Assassins Creed persist but speaking as a fan of AC since the first one (though not so much recently) I am not throwing the games under the bus when I say that AC has never been this good. Not even close. Jin Sakai is a great MC who veers away from the preaching that has become commonplace in Western games and proves that gamers do not need forced MCs who mirror them at the threat of twitter mob outrage. There could be a case made that it is not as long as some other open world games but I would counter that there is no extraneous flab in GoT. Just classy, relevant substance. Its side missions serve a purpose, add to the plot and build the world Jin is trying to save. The add fuel to Jin's desire to save it at all costs. It is so refreshing to have side missions that serve a purpose and aren't just 'Deliver this persons frying pan'. It is a game that makes you care about its casts philosophies without badgering you with encyclopedias on why you're supposed to care (a la Death Stranding). Its world is magical and you want to protect it as much as Jin does. It isnt an exercise in making you feel like crap like TLOU2. It captures the essence of nature and play (which in reality are intertwined anyway). Ghost of Tsushima is a strong contender for Game of the Year and it would take something godlike to deny it.

author: Rune0
quote: This game is a trainwreck. A grimdark story can be excused in certain cases when the gameplay itself is fun but with TLOU2 the creators try to make you regret playing it. Never before have I seen a game trying so hard to make you regret spending your money on it and with the current global situation that is an idiotic philosophy for a video game. I honestly question the sanity of the execs who signed off for this game to be released. It is such a directorial self insert that it may as well be Druckmanns facebook page. From inserting a character almost certainly based on himself who spits on the corpse of the first game to adding parts with his religion and personal politics there can be no doubt that this game is Neil's fantasy or else a physical embodiment of his own arrogance. Who signed off to release this? From the original games heartwarming and brutal paean to the relationship between Fathers and their Daughters to a confused mishmash of hysterical modern political preaching and violence to the point of parody this game wants to be hated to make a point that even it isn't sure about. In places visually stunning but the animations at times leave a lot to be desired. The jump button is useless and the box declaring it as a feature in 2020 is ridiculous. To best sum up TLou2 we must compare it to the first game because it is an unashamed vendetta against everything that made the first game special. It is akin to tearing down a classic painting, burning it and then proclaiming yourself the true artist. I understand certain zeitgeists put deconstruction of a classic on a pedestal but this is just crude and bitter. Even the pseudo Kojima trickery attempted by the trailers was bought by nobody. The fans knew what was coming. The main point of my review is that hardly any of what is in Tlou2 needs to be in a video game. A good video game with a bad story is playable. A bad video game with a good story is acceptable. Tlou2 may have familiar controls to the first game but the game tries to guilt trip you for using them. A survival horror game that tries to guilt trip you for surviving is not worth the plastic its printed on. Do sports games penalise you for scoring? All in all the game sought to elicit a negative response and I hope it gets it because contempt for the fanbase should never be rewarded. The minute you veer towards that you fail as an industry.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: Rune0
quote: Lovecraft Souls. And every bit as perfect as that sounds. A more streamlined combat experience than dark souls but is so in order to focus on aggression. Atmosphere by the bucketload and terror galore. Truly horrorshow. The beasts of bloodborne are not your stereotypical grunting Doom hellspawn - they are twisted (dark) souls screaming in terror as you slash away at eachother. No redneck hunting game has ever gotten this close to truly visceral horror and the grubbiness of the kill. With the patented Dark Souls origami-esque level design always throwing new darkness onto the game world you thought you knew this is an ever-evolving tide into which the player is cast, Worth buying a ps4 just to play? Definitely.

author: Rune0
quote: The best DS game by far. It is DS1 but improved with better gameplay creature comforts and enhanced features. The DLC is still troll-ish but overall this is the best DS we currently have. Only jank and fiddly controls/camera stop this from being a 10. They havent improved that aspect enough to warrant a perfect score. This is still a masterpiece in teaching a player the story via gameplay. Top soundtrack. An essential game. Get it now.

author: Rune0
quote: A decent game but one that comes across as someone elses version of what a DS game should be. It feels like a secondary teams version of the first game. It has the worst level design in the whole series, the least imaginative bosses and the worst soundtrack (though it is still decent). Not a bad game but definitely the worst Dark Souls game. Some of the enemy layouts and areas are just trolling. Overall this is the Dark Souls you get after youve beaten the others and BB and Sekiro.
game_title: Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin

author: Rune0
quote: A brilliant, brutal sprawling epic **** with an origami-like structure. It does more for RPGs than the current generation of lazy ripoffs (COD, Assassins Creed). It suffers from lacking a few home comforts. The warping should be standard (and is in every game after it). The world feels alive but in more of a way where you are aware that you are close to death almost always. Traversal feels more raid-like because you are always aware that youre vulnerable. This is the classic for many many people and i would be inclined to agree but must acknowledge that jankiness and lack of certain gaming standards will deter many.

author: Rune0
quote: This is an unfinished game. Do not pay half of what they are charging you for this game because you will regret it. I paid full price for this game and beat it while messing around in 5 hours. Nemesis feels like a prototype of Mr X from remake 2. He is buggy and will freeze in place staring at you if you enter the toy store. The door will be wide open and Nemesis sticks in place staring at you. They ought to have called it Resi3 Arcade because this is more of a theme park ride than an actual game. I trusted Capcom on the strength of Remake2 but after this? Never again. All mitigating factors are made irrelevant by the fact that theyve packaged this with an online multiplayer game WITH paid gambling mechanics and dlc. In no other industry is this remotely acceptable. I would urge people not to make the same mistake i did. Current global situation aside i wouldve returned this. A case of one step forward and 5 back for Capcom.

author: Rune0
quote:
First and foremost It is a walking sim. The presentation and actors are great and the world looks beautiful but there is very little actual gameplay fun to be had here. Hideos intentions are honourable verging on sickly but the point persists that video games must be fun and there is very little to be found in DS. This is exactly the kind of bloated movie with added game that konami canned him for. In no way is it acceptable to have to skip the same 4 cutscenes every time just to shower. I would urge players to note the amount of times they have thought 'just let me play the game'. And from past experience we know that games that do this lack gameplay - MGS4 for example. At this point Hideo should just go and make movies because the severe amount of bloated pointless garbage in this game renders gameplay an afterthought. It is charming: the cast are great and a few terrible lines aside its a fairly solid (sorry) story. But it is a lot less smart than it believes itself to be. It is everything questionable/bad about Hideos games and please note i am saying this as a fan of 20years and having completed DS and nearly Platinum'd it. It is blatant that Kojima has played and attempted to ripoff games like Journey and Firewatch. DS is a big budget faux-hollywood version of these games. Isolation is a theme throughout but upon beating the game it feels more like an excuse for foisting an empty world on us. I will never condone konamis practices but after experiencing DS i can understand why they kept tabs on the Kojimaisms in all the games hes released. This is not an MGS2-esque prophecy that will be relevant in a decade - it is a knee-jerk pander piece trying to cash in on modern political paranoia. What many will refuse to admit is that after making a series based on the Patriots system of control you spend DS building one yourself amid claims that it will 'bring da people togevur'. The formula for the gameplay we do get is 'Go from A to B dodging ghosts or humans - meet thank you hologram - rinse and repeat' and it is not good enough. I cannot tell you how many times my thumb ached from holding the same direction for minutes on end. A total lack of dynamism. It is honestly an amazon simulator and any majesty the world had evaporates when you can build roads through it. I have lost a lot of faith in my usual trusted reviewers because theyre calling this game a 9+/10 and that is nowhere near true.
Hideo is a genius and the world sorely needs his games. But this is barely a game. I think we have reached the point where he should just go and make movies because this game is an afterthought attached to one.

author: Rune0
quote: Theres no feeling of progression. It is mainly 'yay congrats! you did the thing! now you can up your stats to do the thing again!'. And it has a cashgrabbing predatory design from the get-go.

author: Rune0
quote: It is a great nostalgic journey through MGS folklore. By far the best game on the psp. A 9/10 taking into consideration the limitations of the psp. Its intelligent design using limited resources. A real old school approach. And if youre not dancing along to the music during THAT fight then you have no soul.

author: Rune0
quote: A brilliant sprawling contemporary epic. One of the best soundtracks in video game history that takes you right back to the 90s. Also a brilliant rebuttal to the 'video games must have protagonists that mirror the player' brigade.

author: Rune0
quote: It is a huge brilliant game though not as big as it wants you to think. You're almost permanently slowed down and 'tap x repeatedly to do anything at all' should not be in a game of this price/year/size. I've heard lots of stories of people hurting their hands because of this. The horse riding is awful and many many many times throughout the game you'll fly through the air like a ninja on crack because a rock hasn't bothered loading and was therefore invisible. The story and characters are the best thing ever to come from rockstar and it pains me to rate it so low but what we have here is a top current gen game plastered over ps2 controls. The world is beautiful and really captures the spirit of what a contemporary person would imagine the dying wild west was like.This is a game id love to play more but the controls make it hurt. You cant have sandboxes where you have to repeatedly tap buttons just to move because it makes traversing it a chore. Some could argue that's a theme in the game but that is just mental gymnastics to justify the kind of boring nonsense we hated in GTAV.

author: Rune0
quote: Skyrim is a flawed masterpiece so I gave bethesda the benefit of the doubt and bought Fallout 4. I regret it. The nice-ish graphics would matter more if the frame rate were above 4. It is a juddering janky mess **** that tries to be a jack-of-all-trades but masters none. It is probably why you get a mech suit early on - not many people want to wander through dark brown street after dark brown street. To give a tangible metaphor it is like a chinese-made knockoff sandbox with knock-off toys that comes in a shiny new (£50 at launch) box. It accurately foreshadowed Fallout 76 and bethesdas laziness. I will not be buying another bethesda game after this broken mess.  It plays like a ps1 game.

author: Rune0
quote: It is a brilliant and beautiful yet brutal game. It is my first FromSoft game and I was daunted but intrigued by the whole mythology surrounding these games. I have enjoyed it. It does force you to 'git gud' though and sometimes is like butting your head against a brick wall until you overcome the boss or exploit a weakness. The trademark difficulty will deter most but a cynic will see that it is to hide the fact that there is not a lot of game here. Grinding is VERY time consuming and an absolute necessity. Rules change with every passing enemy. You will be battered mercilessly and it will make the kill all the more satisfying when you finally get lucky. Its one for the hardcore masochist gamers. From a personal perspective it makes me miss Tenchu.

author: Rune0
quote: THE classic of classics. Even today in 2019 it is unmatched in terms of atmosphere. A more intelligent take on action instead of 'lol shoot the badguys'. A story brilliant enough to put weight behind your play and decisions. AKA The moment when video games became art.

author: Rune0
quote: Its the best game on ps4. Even when playing it in between other AAA games the gulf in quality is huge. Yes it was rushed out and the story is polarizing (my bet is that like MGS2 in time it will be understood) but I would rather have a polished game that has me wanting more than...fallout 4.
